release.body:
## Fix
* 240777f fix: preserve held modifiers across repeated key mappings by @Bush2021

    > **Resolves #284** - Mapped shortcuts now keep working across repeated presses while Alt or Ctrl remains held.

* 68a08b1 fix: adapt for Chrome 158 tab container by @Bush2021

    > **Resolves #290** - Fixes compatibility with Chrome 158's horizontal tab strip, including tab closing, mouse-wheel switching, hover activation, and keeping the last tab open.

* 630eefe fix: stop swapped key mappings from looping by @Bush2021

    > Fixes endless remapping with swapped shortcuts such as `F1=F2` and `F2=F1`, so the mapped key can reach Chrome.

* 67461d2 fix: keep registration order for same-priority input handlers by @Bush2021

    > Key mappings now consistently take priority when a mapping and the translate shortcut use the same key combination.


## Maintenance
* 61d76dc chore: update .gitignore by @Bush2021
* 3d56b53 chore: improve issue templates by @Bush2021
* 7665798 chore: remove dead code and unused includes by @Bush2021
* b1810ef refactor: drop tab strip classes from Chrome 150 and earlier by @Bush2021
* 3bf055b refactor: drop casts so Detours type-checks hooks by @Bush2021
* c951132 refactor: share duplicated UIA, tab, INI and input helpers by @Bush2021

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Bush2021/chrome_plus/compare/1.18.2...1.18.3
